gaps: Historic chassis-series production dates, coachbuilt bodies and exact technical data largely remain null.
All14 existing slugs preserved, with retained source bounds. Historical Kappa/Delta/Beta/Gamma/Zeta use distinct slugs to avoid modern identity collisions.
Delta S4 road-homologation, Astura/Artena series and A112 export Lancia badge phases need separate source reconciliation. Jolly/Superjolly identity documented, dates/configurations unknown.
Eight selected configurations: Ypsilon2025, three Fulvia, early Ardea, Y10FIRE, Lambda first series and Flaminia2.8; comprehensive CZ engine/gearbox combinations remain incomplete.
Photos selected only after actual inspection; most generations remain to illustrate.
